outgoing.name: Chicago
outgoing.excerpt: The first permanent Railway Post Office route was established on August 28, 1864 between Chicago, Illinois, and Clinton, Iowa.

outgoing.name: United Kingdom
outgoing.excerpt: The first-ever sorting of mail en route occurred in the United Kingdom with the introduction of the Travelling Post Office in 1838.
